building: South Campus (Campus Sur), IESE headquarters, Avenida Pearson 21
notes: Institution-level campus reference, not a school or department office. IESE's official legal notice states the school is "headquartered in Barcelona, Avenida Pearson, 21" (entity: IESE Business School-University of Navarra), and the official Barcelona campus page names the Av. Pearson 21 site as the South Campus (the North Campus is at Carrer d'Arnús i de Garí 3-7). Coordinates are the OpenStreetMap named point 'IESE Business School' tagged addr Avinguda de Pearson 21, note 'Campus Sur (South Campus)' (node 2681809198), not a city or campus-polygon centroid. IESE also has campuses of standing in Madrid (Camino del Cerro del Águila 3), Munich (Maria-Theresia-Straße 15), New York (165 West 57th Street) and São Paulo (Rua Martiniano de Carvalho 573), plus offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, Hong Kong and Shanghai; this record marks the officially designated headquarters only and makes no claim about where any department sits.
